title: Bio-Sites Premium v1 — structural authoring reference
$comment: Documentation aid, not a replacement for assertPremiumPackage + processPremiumDesign. Cross-field, URL, byte, node, uniqueness and runtime compatibility checks require validar.mjs. See README for known runtime tolerances.

image.description: Empty string, approved /images path, data:image png/jpeg/webp base64 or absolute HTTP(S) URL without credentials; runtime check.

gradient.description: linear-gradient(integerdeg, #RRGGBB [0..100%], ...), angle -360..360, 2..6 stops. Validated by normalizeGradient.

category.description: Case-insensitive membership in catalogo.json categories; runtime check required.
